name: Chả cây
summary: A grilled pork stick sold at Da Lat bánh căn doors and beside the morning xíu mại.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng bánh căn listings name chả cây. The food-tour note prices chả beside bánh mì xíu mại and does not say the two names are one stick.
howToEat: Eat it with the cakes or with the morning bowl. A spice list was not printed.
where: Cây Bơ, 56 Tăng Bạt Hổ. Lệ, 27/44 Yersin. The food-tour note’s xíu mại counters at 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật price a chả.
priceBand: Cây Bơ prints 5,000 VND for chả cây. The food-tour note prints 4,000 VND for chả. The names are not treated as one price.
seoDescription: A grilled pork stick sold at Da Lat bánh căn doors and beside the morning xíu mại.
